title: Wasserstein-Cram\'er-Rao Theory of Unbiased Estimation
abstract: arXiv:2511.07414v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The quantity of interest in the classical Cram\'er-Rao theory of unbiased estimation (e.g., the Cram\'er-Rao lower bound, its exact attainment for exponential families, and asymptotic efficiency of maximum likelihood estimation) is the variance, which represents the instability of an estimator when its value is compared to the value for an independently-sampled data set from the same distribution. In this paper we are interested in a quantity which represents the instability of an estimator when its value is compared to the value for an infinitesimal additive perturbation of the original data set; we refer to this as the "sensitivity" of an estimator. translated_abstract: 经典Cramér-Rao无偏估计理论所关注的量是方差（例如Cramér-Rao下界、该下界在指数族中的精确达到性、以及极大似然估计的渐近有效性），方差刻画的是当估计量的值与来自同一分布的独立采样数据集上的值进行比较时估计量的不稳定性。在本文中，我们关注的是另一个量，它刻画的是当估计量的值与原始数据集经过无穷小加性扰动后的值进行比较时估计量的不稳定性；我们将其称为估计量的“敏感度”。由此建立的敏感度理论基于Wasserstein几何，正如经典方差理论基于Fisher-Rao（等价地，Hellinger）几何一样，这一洞察使我们能够确定一系列与经典结果相类似的理论成果。
tldr: 该论文提出了基于Wasserstein几何的估计量“敏感度”概念，用以刻画数据受到无穷小扰动时估计量的不稳定性，并建立了与经典Cramér-Rao方差理论（基于Fisher-Rao几何）相平行的全新无偏估计理论框架。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a "sensitivity" theory of unbiased estimation based on Wasserstein geometry, which measures estimator instability under infinitesimal perturbations of the data, establishing results parallel to the classical Cramér-Rao variance theory based on Fisher-Rao geometry.
